scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: 13 cross-fit service-rating residuals. Question: does the 'inconsistency' of a passenger's rating pattern (residual of each rating predicted from the OTHER 20 covariates) carry satisfaction signal beyond the absolute ratings?

H51_RESIDUAL_SIGNAL.question: Do cross-fit residual service-rating features (observed rating minus teacher prediction from other covariates) improve fold-0 OOF AUC of the rich-view LGBM?
H51_RESIDUAL_SIGNAL.method: For each of the 13 service-rating columns, train a teacher (HistGB, lr=0.05, 200 iters) to predict that rating from the OTHER 20 covariates, using an inner 10% split carved from FIT only (folds 1-4). Predict the held-out rating on ALL rows (cross-fit: fold-0 rows predicted by a teacher trained on folds 1-4; fold-k rows predicted by a teacher trained on the other folds). residual_j = observed_j - teacher_pred_j. Add the 13 residuals to the 285-feature rich view. Run LGBM (xt_xt_f10 recipe, seed 1) on fold-0: FIT = folds 1-4 (with inner 10% ES from FIT), eval = fold-0. Measure port_delta vs the champion reference and standalone AUC.
H51_RESIDUAL_SIGNAL.leakage: Teachers are cross-fit (never see the row they predict). The residual uses the observed rating (a covariate available at prediction time) minus the out-of-sample teacher prediction. No satisfaction label enters the residual. Fold-safe.
H51_RESIDUAL_SIGNAL.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995 (the screen bar). Otherwise NEGATIVE.
H51_RESIDUAL_SIGNAL.note: Distinct from the closed 'residual-group-bias' attempt (which used group means). This is a per-row cross-fit residual, not a group bias.

non_goals: No new architecture training (teachers are small HistGB).
Only the 13 service ratings are residualized (not Age/Delay, which are continuous and not 'ratings').
